subject: Request: single-invoice onboarding for small monthly retainer (exception)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <procurement@brightcordlabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding request — small monthly retainer, invoice-only path?

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move forward with a small monthly retainer for Redwood inference consulting (est. $3,000/mo) while we evaluate a pilot. Our finance team prefers to submit a single monthly invoice rather than a PO for this engagement while the pilot is under $10k/month.

I've attached our completed vendor onboarding form, a signed SOW (retainer), and W9. Can you confirm what evidence Redwood needs to allow a temporary no-PO onboarding (invoice-only) for this specific engagement? We can provide references, PII handling attestation, and automated invoice delivery via DocuSign or our AP system.

Goal: onboarding and first invoice processed by Nov 30 so we can kick off the pilot Dec 1.

Attachments: BrightCord_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf; SOW-retainer-nov2026.docx; BrightCord_W9.pdf

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
BrightCord Labs
procurement@brightcordlabs.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <procurement@brightcordlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding request — small monthly retainer, invoice-only path?

Marissa / Jonas — tagging you both for procurement view. BrightCord (new prospect) is asking to onboard as a vendor and route invoices monthly without issuing a PO for the pilot (estimated $3k/mo). They attached vendor form, SOW, and W9.

Questions:
- Is there an existing allowance for single-invoice onboarding for pilot retainers under $10k/month?
- If not, what evidence pack would we need to provisionally allow invoice-only (references, signed SOW, SOC2 attestation from vendor, payment terms, sample invoice)?
- Who in procurement/finance needs to sign off on a temporary exception and for how long (30/60/90 days)?

My recommendation: provisional exception for 60 days with the following conditions: sign SOW, vendor completes onboarding form, provide W9 + SOC2 self-attestation (or ISO equivalent), provide AP contact and automated invoice delivery via DocuSign, and finance approval for Net30 invoice routing to accounts payable. If approved, we document in HubSpot and add an expiration / revisit date.

Elena — copying you so you're aware I'm pulling approvals. Marissa / Jonas, can you confirm the minimum evidence list and the approver chain?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <procurement@brightcordlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding request — small monthly retainer, invoice-only path?

Kimberly — thanks for the heads up.

Procurement position (short): we can approve a timeboxed invoice-only onboarding for pilot retainers under $10k/month with the following mandatory items documented before the first invoice is paid: 
- Completed onboarding form (we have it)
- Signed SOW that references Redwood's terms OR an executed procurement addendum (we need to review SOW for missing clauses)
- W9 and bank account confirmation (ACH) — we have W9 but need bank verification (voided check or bank letter)
- Evidence of security posture: SOC2 Type II report OR vendor self-attestation + security questionnaire responses (link or attached PDF)
- AP contact + automated invoice endpoint (DocuSign or Billing portal)
- Procurement sign-off (me) and Finance approval (Jonas) for a 60-day provisional exception; exception will be recorded in HubSpot with expiration on 2027-01-15.

If Jonas and Finance are comfortable with Net30 and bank confirmation (we'll flag for treasury review), I will sign the exception. Please note: exceptions are reversible; if we see invoice disputes or risk signals we reserve the right to require a PO and pause payments until compliance is met.

Next steps for BrightCord (Elena): please upload bank confirmation (voided check) to the Drive link below and complete the short security questionnaire (if you don't have SOC2). I'll review the SOW and call out any required procurement addendum items.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-onboarding-checklist
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BRIGHT-9876

Kimberly — if you want us to expedite, mark this as high priority and I'll route to Jonas directly for finance approval.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <procurement@brightcordlabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding request — small monthly retainer, invoice-only path?

Thanks Marissa / Kimberly — appreciate the clear list. We uploaded a bank letter and filled the security questionnaire this morning (see Drive). We also prepared an automated monthly invoice template and started a DocuSign envelope for the first month's invoice so Redwood AP can receive it directly. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e

I also attached a redlined SOW (we accepted standard terms but added a 30-day termination for pilot) — please review and confirm whether a procurement addendum is necessary.

If procurement and finance can sign the 60-day provisional exception, we'll queue the first invoice for Nov 30.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
BrightCord Labs
